convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for F2a_AO custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, money management, and new-bar detection. Multi-timeframe logic (D1 trend + H12 signal). Cannot auto-convert without replicating custom indicator and library logic.

derived_values.name: Trend direction from D1 candlestick
derived_values.used_by: Entry gate: Trend>0 allows longs, Trend<0 allows shorts

other_exits: Historical signal search: if both open and close permissions are enabled on a side, and no direct close signal exists, the EA scans backward through bars to find the most recent opposite signal and uses that as the close trigger

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT uses fixed lot size from MM input; FREEMARGIN/BALANCE uses MM as deposit fraction; LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE uses MM as loss share fraction. Default is LOT mode with MM=0.1.

custom_logic_notes: Dual-timeframe system: D1 candle determines trend direction (close>open = bullish, only longs allowed; close<open = bearish, only shorts allowed). F2a_AO indicator on H12 generates entry signals on SignalBar=1 (previous bar). Signal reversal closes opposite positions. Historical bar scan for close signals when no direct close signal is present and both open/close permissions are enabled. TrendBar=0 or SignalBar=0 bypasses new-bar check (re-evaluates every tick). Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on data copy failures.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or port F2a_AO custom indicator (3 MAs: filter=3, fast=13, slow=144, outputting two buffers for up/down signals). Must port TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_. Multi-timeframe alignment (D1+H12) requires careful bar synchronization. Money management has 5 modes controlled by MarginMode enum. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to trade functions and may affect pending order logic in the library. Historical backward scan for close signals adds complexity.
